Security: asked about SOC2 and audit logs; also asked if SSO can be enabled for admin console within 2 weeks.

Sales notes: early-stage SMB motion, likely to start with credits then convert to metered usage. High chance to expand to Dedicated if traffic grows. AE recommended sending model cost matrix, sample prompt set to evaluate, and a short perf-run playbook for hosted API.
